messages:
Maya K: quick heads-up — the post-launch search + retarget pack is trending weirdly. CTR on retarget set B is down ~18% week-over-week and CPA is up. dashboard: https://dash.example.com/r/launch-42 :thinking_face:
Jun Park: ugh, saw that spike this morning. do we have the creative breakdown? is it the copy or the audience getting stale?
Maya K: creative fatigue is my hunch — same static carousel for 9 days. also our pacing looks aggressive for retarget during US evening. might be cannibalizing brand spend.
adops-bot: automated alert — pacing threshold crossed for campaign "launch_q2_retarg_B" at 2026-03-21T09:12:45Z. recommended action: reduce hourly budget by 25% and kick creative rotation.
Jun Park: propose reallocate 20% of brand search budget -> retarget evening windows (8p–11p PT) for 48h, plus run a fresh creative set (variant C). if variant C underperforms, revert.
Alex R: Agree. Also recommend a quick A/B with new CTA: "See Redwood in action" vs "Cut token costs today". Add webinar-targeted flow for users who click but don't convert — send 1: invite to product walk-through (short), 2: customer benchmark PDF.
Priya S: Landing page note — variant C should swap hero to a customer benchmark stat + single CTA. Swap the hero image, tighten headline to one line. Also update UTM so we can track creative performance cleanly. Example UTM: 
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=retarg_variantC
```
Jun Park: good call on UTMs. ad tags I'll update now. Jun to adops to push creative rotation at 09:30 PT. Priya, can you drop the new hero by 08:45 so we can QA? @Priya S :mind_blown:
Priya S: will do — uploading hero and alt copy to the creative drive in 20m. will include 2x image sizes and a GIF fallback.
Maya K: For inbound routing: if lead clicks CTA and spends >60s on page but doesn't convert, route to webinar nurture (instead of sales SDR). We want to catch warm-but-not-ready. Alex, can you add that rule to the routing doc?
Alex R: yep, adding rule now. also adding a high-priority segment to retarget list for webinar invites (last 7d site visitors who viewed pricing or benchmarks).
Maya K: timeline: creative live by 10:00 PT, budget shift 10:15 PT, routing update + webinar flow test by EOD. check back here with confirmations. :rocket:
Jun Park: pushing budget change at 10:15 PT — will confirm once live.
adops-bot: action logged — budget adjust job queued (job id: 9f4a).
Priya S: creative uploaded: https://drive.example.com/s/launch-q2/variantC — QA pass scheduled 09:50 PT.
Alex R: routing update done and documented: https://docs.example.com/marketing/routing#launch-q2 — added notes for analytics.
Maya K: thanks team. quick follow-up: let’s snapshot performance at +24h and +72h and reconvene if CPA still > target. :white_check_mark:
Jun Park: noted. will post the +24h snapshot here.
Maya K: +1 — tagging in the retrospective if we need a bigger cadence change. :spiral_calendar:
